description:
Pass the live suite-clock measurement to the duration checker once the transaction fix and timing contract have landed.

## Background

The runner passes the measured suite-clock integer as `--test-suite-ms <integer>`. This task lands after `fsync-dedupe` so the measured suite can pass its budget; final nextest policy tightening is the separate `nextest-final-policy` leaf.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Passes the live `suite-clock` integer milliseconds to the checker as `--test-suite-ms <integer>` in the cargo-ci budget step.
- [hard] REQ-02: Keeps the transaction benchmark decision applied or recorded before enforcement and leaves the checker interface unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: Preserves nextest reporter summaries, doctests, ignored provenance, and every existing budget check.

## Notes

Ordered overlap: `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` is touched after `step-timing-and-clock`, sequenced by this task's dependencies. The task consumes `suite-clock` and `nextest-reporter-evidence`.
title: Wire suite-clock enforcement into the duration checker
